description: This file is an entrypoint shell script for a Docker image based on php:apache. It sets up necessary environment configurations, ensures the document root exists, adjusts permissions, performs some diagnostics, verifies the existence of the apache2-foreground command, and finally executes apache2-foreground to start the server.

methods.name: set -eu
methods.description: Enables script to treat unset variables as errors and to exit on command errors.

methods.name: set -o pipefail
methods.description: Enables pipefail option if supported, so that the script detects errors in piped commands.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Outputs diagnostic and error messages to standard output or standard error.

methods.name: command -v
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system's PATH.

methods.name: mkdir -p
methods.description: Creates the directory structure for the document root if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: chown -R
methods.description: Recursively changes ownership of the document root to www-data user and group.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Replaces the shell process with the apache2-foreground process, handing off control.
